# Comms and Sensor Towers
Colonies have fixed towers that are often broken when you arrive. Getting them working is a job for engineers: only people trained in engineering can repair them.
## Communications Towers
Many radio channels only carry through a working communications tower, including the [bold]Colony[/bold], [bold]CMB[/bold] and faction channels. While no tower is up, those channels go quiet.
To get a tower working: - [bold]Repair it[/bold]: weld its panels back together with a blowtorch. It can take several passes, so examine the tower to see if there's still damage. - [bold]Tune it[/bold]: use a security access tuner on it to add your faction's frequencies. The tower then starts broadcasting them. - [bold]Power it[/bold]: a tower does nothing without power, so fix the local APC and, if need be, the colony's power grid.
If the tower is destroyed or loses power, the channels it carries stop until it's fixed. Guard it.
## Field Antenna Masts
When there's no working tower nearby, you can raise your own. A [bold]field antenna mast[/bold] relays the combat nets (the squad, command, intel, JTAC and MP channels) around it, so a forward position or command post can stay on the net. - [bold]Building it[/bold]: it's a staged job for someone with [bold]engineering training[/bold] (level 2). Pick [bold]antenna mast parts[/bold] from the metal build menu, lay a footing on open ground, raise and weld the lattice, guy it, fit an antenna head from requisitions and tune the feed. The full step list is in [textlink="the AN/PRC-117G guide" link="AU14CommsANPRC"]. - [bold]Keying it[/bold]: a mast only carries the nets of sides whose [bold]COMSEC fill card[/bold] has been loaded into its open feed. An unkeyed mast carries nothing. - [bold]Range[/bold]: full signal out to about 75 tiles, and a weaker signal out to about 100. - [bold]It needs power.[/bold] An unpowered mast relays nothing, so build it in an area whose APC has power, with its equipment channel on. In the field, bring a PACMAN generator and APC electronics to power the area (see [textlink="Power" link="CMUGuideEngPower"]). - [color=red]It can be taken over.[/color] Anyone who opens the feed can load their own side's card into it, and hostile saboteurs can splice a tap into it to listen in. Put it somewhere you can hold. - If it's damaged, weld it back up with a blowtorch. If it's destroyed, everyone relying on it drops off the net.
## Sensor Towers
A working sensor tower tracks unknown lifeforms in the area and shows them on the tactical map.
To repair it, in order: - Weld the plates back together with a [bold]blowtorch[/bold]. - Fix the wiring with [bold]wire cutters[/bold]. - Realign it with a [bold]wrench[/bold]. - Switch it on.
Examine the tower if you're not sure which step comes next. A sensor tower breaks down again at random after a while, so keep checking on it.
